title: Verify rectangle resource lifecycle
changes: Add an opt-in test for previous tilemap parsing and retained rectangle resources across unavailable copied files, Load, Undo, backup restoration and restart using synthetic scratch saves.
validation: Windows test build e206-lifecycle-build-989hfooi passes. The Wine child test in e206-lifecycle-wine-fivnb6pa passes old tilemap parsing, transactional failed attachment, Load/Undo/backup/restart and positive resource reads; Wine drains without a D-Bus assertion.

The original Wine unit reports FAIL because its cleanup safety gate refused a synthetic .sav. Read-only e206-lifecycle-reconcile-za2m7ukk verifies the child result, source and driver identities and unchanged-input check without replay.
limitations: The failed Wine unit and scratch remain retained; the recovery does not change its FAIL receipt. The proof covers one synthetic lifecycle, not every scene or platform. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements.
